info.name: Hotel Reservation Microservices
info.description:
Covers every feature of the hotel reservation system: accounts, availability, quotes, booking with simulated card payments, overlap protection, check-in/out, cancellation and refunds, the shop and payment services on their own, API security, and the web app's access rules.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner, or `newman`). Select the `Hotel reservation (local)` environment and fill in the passwords from `secrets/*.txt`, or generate a filled copy with `./scripts/make-postman-env.sh`. Every run picks new dates and usernames, so it can be repeated.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Picks fresh dates and usernames for this run, so the collection can be run again and again against the same databases without clashing with earlier runs.

request.description: Lists the rooms and prepares the variables used by every later request.

exec: // A random block of dates 60-700 days ahead, so repeated runs don't overlap.
const iso = d => new Date(Date.now() + d * day).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

item.name: 1. Accounts (hotel management)
item.description: Guest registration and sign-in checks used by the web app. Administrators are pre-created from the admin_password secret.

exec: pm.test("Each room has a rate and status", () => pm.response.json().forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.nightlyRate).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r.status).to.be.a("string"); }));
pm.test("Rooms 101, 204 and 305 are free", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().rooms.map(r => r.roomNumber)).to.include.members(["101", "204", "305"]));
pm.test(".error is Check-in can't be in the past.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Check-in can't be in the past."));
pm.test(".error is Stays are limited to 30 nights.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Stays are limited to 30 nights."));

item.name: 3. Booking and payment (hotel management → shop → payment)
item.description: Quote, book with a card, overlap protection, check-in and check-out.

item.name: Quote room 204 with breakfast and spa

exec: pm.test(".breakdown is Room stay + Breakfast + Spa package", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().breakdown).to.eql("Room stay + Breakfast + Spa package"));

item.name: Book room 204 with an approved card

exec: pm.test(".error is Room 204 is already booked for those dates.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Room 204 is already booked for those dates."));
pm.test("204 is not listed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().rooms.map(r => r.roomNumber)).to.not.include("204"));

item.name: Back-to-back stay in room 204 is allowed

request.description: Check-in on the day the previous guest checks out.

exec: pm.test(".error is Payment declined: Insufficient funds.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Payment declined: Insufficient funds."));
pm.test("305 is still listed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().rooms.map(r => r.roomNumber)).to.include("305"));

item.name: 4. Cancellation and refunds
item.description: Guests cancel their own reservations; administrators cancel any. Cancelling refunds the payment and frees the dates.

item.name: Book room 305 (to be cancelled by an admin)
5. Shop service
item.description: Pricing strategy (seasonal × 1.2) and the extras price list from the shop database.

item.name: Quote 3 nights with breakfast and spa

exec: pm.test(".breakdown is Room stay + Airport transfer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().breakdown).to.eql("Room stay + Airport transfer"));

item.name: 6. Payment service (simulated card network)
item.description: Test cards decide the outcome. Only the card brand and last four digits are stored.

item.name: Charge with the approved test card
Card is masked in the response

exec: pm.test(".declineReason is Your card was declined.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().declineReason).to.eql("Your card was declined."));
pm.test(".declineReason is The card has expired.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().declineReason).to.eql("The card has expired."));
pm.test(".declineReason is Card number is not valid.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().declineReason).to.eql("Card number is not valid."));
pm.test(".declineReason is The card has expired.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().declineReason).to.eql("The card has expired."));

item.name: 7. Security
item.description: Every API needs its own credentials; services don't accept each other's.

item.name: Hotel API with a wrong password → 401
Shop API with the payment credentials → 401
8. Web app (pages and access rules)
item.description: The browser interface. Booking and administration pages need a signed-in user; use a browser at {{webUrl}} for the full click-through (forms carry CSRF tokens).
